test_programs: all compatibility-selected new test families, without replacement after performance

final_measurement.deduplicate: direct executable bytes within each program, retain all method aliases

selection: All data, learning rate, budgets, main weights and this evaluation recipe freeze before any test model inference. No test feedback. Matched full-argmax suffixes are diagnostic and never feed training; raw paths are not early-stage all-advance q labels.
